content.text: {"sections":[{"section":"summary","body":"Pellucid Sensors met each of its covenants on the Venture Term Loan for the period ended October 31, 2026, and the compliance certificate agrees with the bank's calculation on each. The main change is a narrowing cushion on the Minimum Unrestricted Cash covenant, now {{fact:01873dcf-8c7e-48d6-9d33-e2674db02b62}}, which raised a low-severity early warning signal. No open work items are recorded, and the facts held show nothing that requires a decision this period."},{"section":"covenants","body":"Minimum Runway was calculated at {{fact:d7ad1423-b9a8-4940-80da-ad26b627acdf}} against a required {{fact:8144c85b-464e-4d83-b6cd-4317caabc1cc}}, a cushion of {{fact:02e8144c-d4ab-45b9-942c-ca58e5b1e4dd}}. Minimum Unrestricted Cash was {{fact:a3fc1318-7943-4364-b576-965fe50b05e1}} against a required {{fact:bcec0827-9b8b-471d-b72b-f6e0c945777c}}, a cushion of {{fact:01873dcf-8c7e-48d6-9d33-e2674db02b62}}. Revenue to Plan was {{fact:8c52854e-f5e4-4564-a4e6-471c3df0aae3}} against a required {{fact:fa2de281-6ac3-4f27-b302-8ff411b8abf2}}, a cushion of {{fact:f2b8efd6-4299-4080-8e54-ce31feac0671}}. Each covenant is compliant. The certificate reports {{fact:d944a3cf-d1f4-44e4-babf-39c8b5f0f456}}, {{fact:514142af-79c6-4e7a-889f-d31925e55b92}} and {{fact:c05292fa-97fb-4097-9ee1-bf5f869aa2a5}} respectively, matching the bank's figures, and claims compliance on each."},{"section":"risks","body":"A low-severity signal fired: the cushion over the Minimum Unrestricted Cash covenant has narrowed each month since August, reaching {{fact:01873dcf-8c7e-48d6-9d33-e2674db02b62}} in October, which may reflect ongoing cash burn. Unrestricted cash of {{fact:a3fc1318-7943-4364-b576-965fe50b05e1}} remains above the {{fact:bcec0827-9b8b-471d-b72b-f6e0c945777c}} floor. The August cushion figure is not among the facts held here, so a reviewer may wish to confirm the size of the monthly decline against the source data. No other signals fired and no work items are open."}]}
